#### 1. General Descriptions

Apacer AS2280Q4 (M.2 2280) is the next generation modularized Solid State Drive (SSD) with the shape of all new M.2 form factor, aimed to be the more suitable for mobile and compact computers with standard width at only 22.00 mm. AS2280Q4 appears in M.2 2280 mechanical dimensions and is believed to be the leading add-in storage solution for future host computing systems.

The M.2 SSD is designed with PCIE connector pinouts, providing full compliance with the latest PCIe Gen4 x 4 interface specifications. Aside from PCIe compliance, AS2280Q4 delivers exceptional performance and power efficiency. On the other hand, the extreme thin and light form factor makes AS2280Q4 the ideal choice for mobile computing systems, which appears to be the trend in near future.

Regarding reliability, AS2280Q4 is built with a powerful PCIe controller that supports on-the-module ECC as well as efficient wear leveling scheme. In terms of power efficiency, AS2280Q4 is compliant with PCIe Gen4 x 4 interface standard so that it can operate on power management modes, which greatly save on power consumption.
